italian-reading-5.title: G and GH
italian-reading-5.subtitle: Hear the difference between G and GH
italian-reading-5.description: Distinguish soft G in ge/gi from hard G in ghe/ghi.

ir5-p1.translations: Gina eats spaghetti with mushrooms. Then she gets an ice cream.

ir5-t1.text: In ge and gi, G has a soft sound: gelato, giraffa.

ir5-t2.text: In ghe and ghi, H keeps the hard G sound; H is not pronounced separately.

ir5_q1.question: In which combinations does G have the soft sound?

ir5_q2.question: What does H do in ghe and ghi?

options.ir5_q2_opt1: Keeps the hard G sound before E and I
options.ir5_q2_opt2: Creates a separate sound after G
options.ir5_q2_opt3: Changes G to the soft sound

ir5_q3.question: Which word has the soft G sound?

ir5_q4.question: Which spelling has hard G before I?
